summary: Practise hotel budgeting, forecasting, USALI reporting and KPI analysis. Explore the course and see how it fits your hotel finance role.
lede: Hospitality financial management helps hotel finance and operating professionals plan budgets and assess departmental results. Through practical exercises, they practise USALI-based profit-and-loss reporting, calculating hotel measures such as ADR, RevPAR and GOPPAR, and reviewing budget variances. They also build rolling forecasts, cash-flow views and Excel KPI dashboards to explain financial performance and inform operating decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for hotel finance and operating professionals who prepare, review or act on departmental financial results.
audience: Hospitality Operations Directors using financial reports
modules: Hotel Financial Review and Action Planning
prerequisites: Working knowledge of hotel operations or basic financial statements is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use hotel financial calculations and Excel.
